column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “sojourn” is rendered “abide,” and “mountain” as “hill.”
Close to the Hebrew; “blameless” is rendered “with integrity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “kinsman” is rendered “friend.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he swears to do harm” is rendered “He swears to his own hurt.”
